criteria.subject: Neutral readiness
criteria.description: Future implementation must realize readiness evaluation only.
criteria.pass_condition: readiness is evaluated without runtime activation
criteria.fail_condition: activation runtime or owner-private reach-in appears

criteria.subject: Registry neutrality
criteria.description: Future implementation must preserve Master Layer Registry authority.
criteria.expected_result: No duplicate registry or unregistered integration.
criteria.pass_condition: all owners map to canonical registry
criteria.fail_condition: parallel registry or duplicate ownership appears

criteria.subject: Evidence provenance
criteria.description: Every criterion must map to EPL-1 evidence.
criteria.expected_result: No orphan evidence and no orphan criteria.
criteria.pass_condition: all evidence maps to EPL-1 category and chain-of-custody

criteria.subject: Implementation prohibition
criteria.description: Phase 4 must not introduce implementation, runtime, API, frontend, persistence, deployment, infrastructure, schema, registry mutation, or publication.
criteria.expected_result: Only governance artifacts, validator, and tests are present.
